title: FRED Housing Market Indicators
description: Tracks U.S. housing market health via housing starts, building permits, existing home sales, the Case-Shiller Home Price Index, and 30-year mortgage rates. Housing is the most interest-rate-sensitive sector - when mortgage rates drop, housing leads the recovery. Permits are a leading indicator (6-9 months ahead of completions). Falling permits + rising rates = housing slowdown incoming.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'
API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

SERIES = [
    ('HOUST', 'housing_starts', 'Housing Starts (thousands, SAAR)'),
    ('PERMIT', 'building_permits', 'Building Permits (thousands, SAAR)'),
    ('EXHOSLUSM495S', 'existing_home_sales', 'Existing Home Sales (millions, SAAR)'),
    ('CSUSHPINSA', 'case_shiller_index', 'Case-Shiller U.S. National Home Price Index'),
    ('MORTGAGE30US', 'mortgage_30y', '30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate'),
    ('MORTGAGE15US', 'mortgage_15y', '15-Year Fixed Mortgage Rate'),
    ('MSACSR', 'months_supply', 'Monthly Supply of New Houses'),
]

rows = []
for i in range(len(SERIES)):
    series_id = SERIES[i][0]
    label = SERIES[i][1]
    description = SERIES[i][2]

    resp = requests.get(
        BASE,
        params={
            'series_id': series_id,
            'api_key': API_KEY,
            'file_type': 'json',
            'sort_order': 'desc',
            'limit': 13,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    obs = resp.json().get('observations', [])

    valid = []
    for o in obs:
        if o.get('value', '.') != '.':
            valid.append(o)

    if not valid:
        continue

    latest = float(valid[0]['value'])
    prev = float(valid[1]['value']) if len(valid) >= 2 else latest
    mom_change_pct = round(((latest - prev) / prev) * 100, 2) if prev != 0 else 0.0

    yoy_change_pct = 0.0
    if len(valid) >= 13:
        year_ago = float(valid[12]['value'])
        yoy_change_pct = round(((latest - year_ago) / year_ago) * 100, 2) if year_ago != 0 else 0.0

    # Housing market signal
    if 'mortgage' in label:
        if latest > 7.0:
            signal = 'RESTRICTIVE'
        elif latest > 6.0:
            signal = 'ELEVATED'
        elif latest > 5.0:
            signal = 'MODERATE'
        else:
            signal = 'STIMULATIVE'
    elif label == 'months_supply':
        if latest > 8.0:
            signal = 'BUYERS_MARKET'
        elif latest < 4.0:
            signal = 'SELLERS_MARKET'
        else:
            signal = 'BALANCED'
    else:
        if mom_change_pct > 3.0:
            signal = 'STRONG_GROWTH'
        elif mom_change_pct > 0:
            signal = 'GROWING'
        elif mom_change_pct > -3.0:
            signal = 'SOFTENING'
        else:
            signal = 'DECLINING'

    rows.append({
        'series_id': series_id,
        'metric': label,
        'description': description,
        'latest_value': latest,
        'latest_date': valid[0].get('date', ''),
        'prior_value': prev,
        'mom_change_pct': mom_change_pct,
        'yoy_change_pct': yoy_change_pct,
        'market_signal': signal,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
